title: Corporate Venue Booking Enquiry
scene: Everyday transactional phone call between a retreat centre representative and a corporate client.
sample_context: Polite, clear form-filling interaction with natural corrections of names, dates, and prices.

speakers.audio_profile: Polite, structured, and helpful customer service agent.

director_note.disfluencies: Minimal; clear read-backs of key data

speakers.audio_profile: Professional corporate client making an enquiry.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Good morning, Beaumont Retreat Centre, Sarah speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Hello, yes. I'm looking to book a venue for a company strategy weekend.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Excellent. First of all, could I get the name of your company?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: It's the Beaumont Financial Group. Oh wait, sorry, that's my old firm! I recently moved. It's actually for Sterling Associates.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: No problem. And your name?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Mark Thurlow.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Right, Mark. What dates were you hoping for?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: We originally wanted the weekend of the 20th of October, arriving on the Friday.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Ah, I'm afraid we have a large wedding party booked that entire weekend. We do, however, have full availability the following weekend, starting on the 27th of October.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: The 27th... Yes, that should work perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Great. For our main conference room, the standard weekend hire is usually £1,600. However, because your group is relatively small, I can offer our corporate tier rate, bringing the total down to £1,450.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: That's £1,450? Brilliant, I'll note that down. Does that include audio-visual equipment?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: It includes the PA system and microphones. We can provide a projector for an additional small fee, or you can bring your own.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: We definitely need a projector, so please add that to the booking. We won't need extra microphones though.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Noted. Now, regarding catering, we offer a mixed buffet, but please let us know if there are specific dietary requirements.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Well, a few team members are gluten-free, but honestly, it's much easier if you just make the entire spread vegetarian. That covers almost everyone safely.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: A fully vegetarian menu, understood. You'll also be pleased to know that unlike many venues in the area, our pricing includes secure parking for all attendees.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Oh, that is a relief. Street parking is a nightmare around there. What about the rooms themselves?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: The executive suites we've reserved for your team all feature a private balcony overlooking the lake. It's quite serene for evening unwinding.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Sounds ideal. What are the next steps?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I'll email the contract. Just ensure you send back a signed copy along with proof of your corporate liability insurance. We legally require that on file before any event.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Will do. You can reach me on my direct mobile if you need anything urgently: it's 07844 299 011.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: 07844 299 011. Got it. Once the paperwork is sorted, you just need to pay a deposit to secure the dates.
